model_evidence.paired_repeatability: Synthetic pairs of corresponding calibrated block estimates from two states. Independent pairs of blocks, stable and approximately Gaussian repeatability assumed here.
model_evidence.external_input_independence: Synthetic gain certificate and transfer correction are independent of each other and of the paired block estimates.
model_evidence.type_b_dof: Certificate scale and rectangular limits are treated as effectively known in this example.
model_evidence.correction_inventory: Signed C for transfer, timing, dark events and rate corrections after accounting for the tagged opportunity definition. Hypothetical aggregate input with a stated rectangular distribution.
model_evidence.approximate_95_percent: Illustrative symmetric block variations. The block contrast dominates. Student-t with effective degrees of freedom is an approximate reporting interval only.
model_evidence.data_origin: Constructed block probability estimates for testing arithmetic, no measured counts or issued certificate.
